bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1) Bill 2026

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2026-06-25.107.2): "*That the amendments be agreed to.*" In other words, they voted to agree with the Senate's amendments to the bill. This means that the final version of the bill has now been passed in both houses of parliament and so can now become law. ### What were the Senate amendments? See the [supplementary explanatory memorandum](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fems%2Fr7493_ems_e5a9c782-fb39-4705-968e-e258fc04c742%22;rec=0) for more information about [these amendments](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fsched%2Fr7493_sched_776af8ad-0010-41d2-8b19-b20a5ac02cf5%22;rec=0).
